question: The Viceroy who took keen interest in the restoration and protection of historical monuments was ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Curzon.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Lord Curzon **served as the **Viceroy of India** from **1899 to 1905** and was known for his interest in **preserving historical monuments.**
 
• Lord Curzon established the **Ancient Monuments Preservation Act (1904**), which was responsible for the conservation and restoration of ancient monuments and archaeological sites. 
 
• Under his leadership, several important monuments including the **Taj Mahal, Qutub Minar, and Fatehpur Sikri **were restored and preserved for future generations.
